title: Improving LLM Interpretability with User-Centric Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.26166v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Advancing reasoning capabilities allow large language models (LLMs) to tackle increasingly complex problems, while reasoning traces - intermediate steps toward solutions - open up high-stakes applications by enabling human inspection of AI decision-making. However, current approaches prioritize model performance over human interpretability, limiting effective human-AI collaboration. In this study, we design and evaluate a human-centered approach that structures reasoning traces based on self-contained, verifiable steps, enabling users to independently assess and correct AI reasoning. Our approach uses XML-like tags to encode reasoning content and metadata, facilitating targeted feedback. Evaluation on mathematical reasoning tasks shows our approach maintains equivalent performance to standard Chain-of-Thought reasoning while enhancing interpretability. translated_title: 提升大语言模型可解释性的用户中心思维链推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26166v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：推理能力的进步使大语言模型（LLMs）能够处理日益复杂的问题，而推理轨迹（即通往解决方案的中间步骤）通过允许人类检查AI决策过程，开启了高风险应用的可能性。然而，当前方法优先考虑模型性能而非人类可解释性，限制了有效的人机协作。在本研究中，我们设计并评估了一种以人为中心的方法，该方法基于自包含、可验证的步骤来构建推理轨迹，使用户能够独立评估和纠正AI推理。我们的方法使用类似XML的标签来编码推理内容和元数据，从而促进有针对性的反馈。在数学推理任务上的评估表明，我们的方法在保持与标准思维链推理相当性能的同时，增强了可解释性。用户研究显示，在感知有用性和易用性方面有显著提升。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于自包含可验证步骤和XML标签的用户中心思维链方法，在保持数学推理性能的同时显著提升模型可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a user-centric chain-of-thought approach using self-contained verifiable steps and XML-like tags, maintaining mathematical reasoning performance while significantly enhancing interpretability.
